replace_division_node: replace a DivisionNode with multiplication or power operations supported by BMG
replace_logarithm_nodes: replace Log10Node, Log2Node, or Log1pNode with equivalent log and multiplication BMG nodes
replace_switch_node: replace a SwitchNode with if-then-else or choice BMG nodes based on the switch type
unsupported_node_fixer: create a NodeFixer that replaces unsupported BMG nodes with semantically equivalent supported nodes
unsupported_node_reporter: report errors for BMG nodes that are not supported by the Bean Machine Graph compiler
